notes.message: Exporter and importer report substantially different net weights for this same corridor. Both fields are marked non-estimated by Comtrade. Values must be labelled by reporting side, not presented as a reconciled physical quantity. No conversion or averaging has been applied.
notes.method: Official export and import netWgt fields independently divided by 1000. Difference remains unresolved; do not infer ore grade or replace either record from trade value.

scope: Targeted mirror audit of one salient corridor, not a systematic mirror validation of all rows.
